finding: The run-to-run spread exceeds the size of any change this project has tried to measure. Across three runs the pass rate spans 4-6 of 11, the reachable count 6-9 of 11, and the median top-pose RMSD 1.75-4.27 A. The scoring-versus-sampling split inverts between runs (4 scoring/2 sampling, then 1/4, then 2/5). At 12 Monte Carlo runs by 3000 steps this benchmark cannot resolve a one- or two-case effect, which is the magnitude of every scoring or search change in the roadmap.
consequence: No single number should be published as the benchmark result, and no scoring or search improvement can be validated against this benchmark as currently configured. Quoting one run - including the most flattering - would be reading noise as a result.
nextStep: Raise the search budget until a repeat run reproduces itself, then report mean and spread over several seeds rather than a single figure. Until that is done the honest published form is a range.
